description: This file defines a feature for deleting comments within an ASP.NET Core application using MediatR. It includes a command structure, validation logic, and a request handler that interacts with Entity Framework Core to remove a comment from an article identified by a slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug in the delete command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of a comment associated with an article identified by slug, throwing appropriate exceptions if not found.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to locate the article by slug, find the comment by ID, remove it from the context, and save changes asynchronously.
